answer: At 37 units per epoch, sustaining 67 aliases for 29 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the copycat. The fee is charged through a dune debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the meadow totals, and the lotus anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. Each active identity pays a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. A farm of 47 pays that 89 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
